in_marathi.name: Banamali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady with lotus in hand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banamali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bana: to adorn, Mali: lotus. Banamali is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. She is often depicted holding a lotus in her hand, representing creation and purity. The name Banamali is a tribute to her grace and abundance.
